attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Speech Language Pathology and Audiology (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities sponsored by ASHA, the American Academy of Audiology, a state department of education, other IACET-authorized providers, and/or ACCME CME units: conferences, seminars, self-study, courses, workshops, or course work from an accredited institution
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed by examination after the July 1 renewal date: exempt until the next renewal cycle (June 30 of the second year after issuance).
rules.audit_note: Keep course descriptions and proof of attendance at least 4 years; subject to random audit by the Department.
rules.notes: Holders of both an SLP and an audiology license need at least 30 clock hours per two years. CE must be completed by June 30 of even years. The Board may extend, reduce or waive CE for hardship. Speech-language support personnel (assistants) have no CE requirement in the rule. The statute (§5-48.2-11) may add a cultural competency hour requirement; its official text could not be opened from our location, so check it before renewal.
rules.rule_quote: A. On or before the thirtieth (30th) day of June of even years, every person licensed to practice speech language pathology and/or audiology within Rhode Island shall complete not less than twenty (20) clock hours of continuing education within the preceding two (2) years…
